States.note: as='button' rows covering active (bg-selected chip), resting, disabled (dimmed muted ink) and a non-interactive row with no onPress. The active/resting separation the component's comment describes is visible.

SessionRows.note: The surface carrying real row content — icon, truncating session/branch/command label, trailing sidebar-tone Badge. Shows why the component is a surface rather than a row: children own the anatomy.

AsDiv.note: as='div' branch list: an active div row with a 'default' badge, an interactive div row, and a presentational row with no onPress. Rendered content rather than bare labels so the cell reads as a real composition.

TwoLineRow.note: Height override (h-auto flex-col) proving the surface stretches for a two-line repo row — title plus muted status line — with the active chip wrapping both lines.
